body:
Diclazepam was on point ml to ml fantastic product.
First off I took 2mg diclazepam late last night. 30-40 minutes in the diclazepam peak I decided to blast off 100mg of deams. Both drugs hit at the same time. Tripping just as hard as usual but with more sedative type of deal. Like I hit ego death a few times for a second.
Idk in my conclusion some benzos enhance the effects of DMT. It was like a sedated blast off. Might be my favorite combination.
